key_insight: Period-shifted snapshot analysis recovers Floquet multipliers and time-periodic modes, revealing stability in systems that a single constant DMD operator cannot represent.
engineering_relevance: The method supports stability analysis of periodically varying flows and measurements, including combustor dynamics and rotating structures.
method: FD applies DMD to snapshots subsampled once per period.
EFD stacks each period’s snapshots to recover shared multipliers and phase-resolved modes.
EFD can handle partial measurements when observations over one period determine the state.
evidence_signal: The methods are verified against known multipliers and illustrated using velocity, scalar, and acoustic-pressure measurements from a swirl-stabilized combustor.
watch_item: Exactness requires linear time-periodic dynamics and sufficient observability; nonlinear or noisy data can bias multiplier moduli, which should not be interpreted as decay rates.
paper_title: Floquet Decomposition: Floquet Multipliers and Time-Periodic Modes from Period-Sampled Snapshot Data
